title: A branch sees the open work that touches what it touches: nugit overlap and pr-render -overlap list the open PRs and recently pushed branches that change the same files, C4 components or store keys, and which of them would conflict
acceptance_criteria: nugit overlap lists open PRs (gh) and remote branches pushed within -recent with no open PR whose change shares a file, a component (one model maps both) or an added record id or decision number with this branch, collisions first; shared files are merged in simulation and the conflicting ones named; work on this branch's own line (ancestor or stacked) is left out, squash-merged branches too; -pairs compares every two; nothing is fetched and no gh falls back to branches; pr-render -overlap adds the section, never a finding, never the exit code, and without the flag its output is byte-identical
